description: Unofficial native WhatsApp desktop client built with Rust, with linked devices, chat history, media, calls, and notifications.
notes: The Windows ZIP is the publisher's portable distribution. The upstream release workflow packages zapfast.exe, README.md, LICENSE, THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md, and zapfast-portable.txt inside a versioned wrapper directory; extract_dir matches that layout.

Keep zapfast-portable.txt beside zapfast.exe. The marker tells ZapFast's built-in updater that this is a portable installation. The app can update itself independently of Scoop, so use one update route consistently; the manifest does not remove or disable the built-in updater.

Settings are stored under %APPDATA%\paolino\zapfast\config, session data and the encrypted message archive under %LOCALAPPDATA%\paolino\zapfast\data, and caches under %LOCALAPPDATA%\paolino\zapfast\cache. These paths are outside the Scoop app directory, so no persist directive is needed. The archive key is kept in Windows Credential Manager.

Portable builds register the AppUserModelID HKCU\Software\Classes\AppUserModelId\me.paolino.zapfast at runtime for Windows notifications. This is application runtime integration, not an installer or registration performed by Scoop.
ZapFast requires a graphics driver that supports OpenGL 2.1 or newer. Exit the app before updating or uninstalling it through Scoop.

ZapFast is an unofficial WhatsApp client and is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta; the publisher warns that using an unofficial client may be against WhatsApp's terms and could result in account suspension.
